deco_smdg_desc: Smudge tool, blends surrounding deco together
ngrv_desc: Creates a short-lasting negative gravity well.
part_desc: Spawn a single particle of the selected element, launched along the drag
prop_desc: Property tool: rewrite one particle property (tmp, life, ctype, temp, vx, vy, ...) under the brush; opens the property window
sign_desc: Place text signs on the canvas; click a sign to edit it
smpl_desc: Sample the element or wall under the cursor into the primary tool
